name: 31468-gsm8kwindowed-qwen8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B as the target with z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16 as the draft head, 18.5 GB of weights together; both ungated. The draft was trained against this exact target and is not interchangeable with another checkpoint.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism; this engine refuses DFLASH with data-parallel attention or pp_size > 1.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=2, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Five-shot GSM8K in this engine's own gsm8k completion format, shipped with the item as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-1319.jsonl: all 1319 rows of the test split, one turn each, raw text to /v1/completions with no chat template. Against this target's tokenizer prompts are 854 tokens mean (sd 22, min 816, max 981), sharing a 792-token five-shot preamble; generation is greedy (temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0, top_k 1), capped at 2048 new tokens with the harness's three stop strings, and stops naturally near 124 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math solver answering five-shot word problems with a draft model, two concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by `commit_id` in setupcard.md. One H100 serving Qwen3-8B
# with DFLASH speculative decoding to two concurrent streams of five-shot GSM8K.
# Everything not named below is a stock default of that commit.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1

speculative-algorithm: DFLASH
speculative-draft-model-path: z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 16
# The engine requires this to be >= speculative-num-draft-tokens. Check the init line echoes
# `draft_window_size=512`: if the flag never reached the engine the server still starts at rc=0.
speculative-draft-window-size: 512

# An attention backend the draft worker does not accept by name is not an error here: it
# falls back to flashinfer silently. fa3 is accepted for both the target and the draft.
attention-backend: fa3
speculative-draft-attention-backend: fa3
